notes.title: Which Wizard is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello Wizards! :D

Next Fest was a blast- we enjoyed playing with new folks and seeing people have fun with the game! 

We're continuing the magic by hopping into Early Access! This is a major milestone for the game and we can't wait to continue improving the game alongside the help of the players. To celebrate the launch, the game is 20% off for a limited time!


For those who have never played Which Wizard before- below are a few of the things that makes Which Wizard different from similar games in the genre. :) 

[list]
[*] Every wizard gets a random subclass, which grants you a special ability that changes your strategies and capabilites
[*] Your subclass DOES NOT indicate if you are good or evil. So watch out for "Healers" that are actually wolves in sheep's clothing!
[*] Everyone has access to "Transfrogrify", a spell that turns a target wizard into a frog. Frogs can't do spells! (A great defense against evil wizards!)
[*] Your magic is draining, if it runs out you can't cast spells. Doing Quests will give you your magic back. In some Lobby Settings you can make having zero magic a bit more... deadly. This mechanic makes "puppy guarding" not nearly as effective or wise to do.
[*] Ghosts haunt the castle! Instead of needing to finish up Quests, Ghosts instead can stay spectating the action while playing their own game. Every voting session the Ghost with the most points gets to decide the next round's Haunt. Haunts change elements of map. Make it windy, alter spell cooldowns, or start a party!
[*] Evil Wizards can see Ghosts. They serve as constant reminders for the terrible murders you've committed.
[*] Tons of lobby settings, text chat, and different servers worldwide.
[*] You can pet a cute dragon named Meemo.
[/list]



Like I said previously, this is a big milestone for Which Wizard and the team that made it. We're super excited to have it publicly available to play! Also huge thanks to all the players who have joined throughout Which Wizard's development so far- I'm so excited to see what comes to Which Wizard in the next phase of it's development! :D
